method: Existing12 samples only. No executions, exclusions, reordered pairs or changed acceptance. p95 uses sorted[floor(0.95*N)]; slow threshold33.333333ms is two60Hz steps. Half-by-frame and half-by-logic-step shown separately. CPU is whole Godot process aggregated across threads.

protocol.rule: Exactly three paired rounds; report every signed A-B difference and drift. No result-dependent extra rounds. Full effects and workload retained; no process termination or request to stop other user work.
protocol.purpose: Final GPU beam acceptance including finite-input and culling-bounds fixes. Exactly three new paired rounds; prior de7ce8d2 samples not reused as acceptance. No correctness rerun or extra locator run.

protocol.rule: Exactly three short interleaved pairs, all samples reported, no result-dependent extra runs. Full scene/workload and same DLL. Unaccepted GPU beam candidate stays in both code trees but is disabled on both sides.

findings.remaining: 3 slow frames at183/184 immediately follow the180-step boundary. Association with simulation phase is proven; its producer is not identifiable in clean runs with empty phases.
findings.warmup: All12 before snapshots equal:180 steps,1178 fires,2925 hits,1836 purchases, game clock3.12; each final sample240 steps. GPU B1/B2/B3 all66 live quad builds before sampling. Damage B1/B2/B3 metric caches already built1054/1058/1052 rows. This proves workload warmup and prior use, not equivalent driver/font/OS caches.
findings.cold_start: No uniform first-candidate warm-up signature: GPU B1 slows in first half, damage B1 slows in second half; GPU B3 also has a slow first half. First-pair medians are negative too. Normal logs contain no compilation/import messages, but no compile/cache-hit telemetry was recorded; absence of such logs does not prove absence of lazy compilation.
findings.cpu: All process CPU windows aggregate all Godot threads. They cannot reveal main-thread preemption or distinguish GPU waits, engine contention and other processes. CPU values quantize to15.625ms. Wall-clock frame timestamps include any scheduling delays inside the interval. No scheduler trace, external process load or per-frame/thread CPU data exists.
findings.measurement_limits: Shared isolated project/cache across sequential fresh processes; no cache reset/precompiled-cache manifest or warmup wall/render-frame history. Fixed3s simulation warmup does not establish equal rendered warmup count. Deterministic A1 B1 B2 A2 A3 B3 order and one run/cell do not identify time/order effects independently from treatment. This is a design limitation, not proof of a particular bias direction.
findings.acceptance: Preserve original all-sample decisions and signed differences. No samples removed and no new test requested/performed. Neither first negative pair can be assigned to external user work or startup compilation from these records.
